_note: Real low-carbon infrastructure vendors across Singapore, Bangkok and Hanoi, compiled from two rounds of sourced research (company/government sites, SGX/SET filings, procurement records, press). Each vendor carries a verification tag — 'verified' (sourced), 'partial' (company real, specific claim secondhand), 'indicative' (name confirmed, capability inferred). Circular flags (takeback/secondLife/recycledContent) drive the take-back filter on the Act page.
rating_basis: Rating is an INDICATIVE credibility signal derived from verified market standing, government endorsement and track record in the sourced research — NOT aggregated customer reviews. Labelled indicative; production would replace it with procurement-record ratings.

verification_labels.verified: Sourced from company/government sites, filings or press
verification_labels.partial: Company is real; the specific capability claim is secondhand
verification_labels.indicative: Company confirmed; capability inferred from sector activity
